scopeStatement: Reconstruction of video-internal speech, raw machine SRT, burned captions, visible filmed-monitor/UI states, pointer actions, editing order, non-speech audio findings, and bounded absences across 0.00-29.80 seconds. It does not externally verify product claims, identify the source of photographed materials or the cartoon, or infer hidden operations from montage adjacency.

viewerChange.before: The viewer may know DeepSeek as a general chat system without a concrete English-study workflow.
viewerChange.after: The video asks the viewer to see a photographed vocabulary list plus prompt as a route to interactive HTML exercises, answer explanations, listening-style material, and mnemonic guidance, while the evidence leaves the complete execution chain, TTS playback, retention efficacy, and cartoon provenance unestablished.
intendedChanges: Understand the author-proposed vocabulary-image to prompt to HTML-exercise pattern.
Observe one four-option page whose option A reveals a green answer hint on hover.
Recognize the additional visible cloze, answer-analysis, listening-comprehension, and mnemonic states as edited examples rather than a continuous proven run.
Receive the author's persuasive framing that the approach is interesting, memorable, and especially suitable for English learners.

limitations: Frames are sampled observations, not proof of unsampled actions or whole intervals.
Repeated times may occur under different protocol actions.

derivedSources.kind: macOS Vision OCR proposals for targeted frames
limitations: OCR is machine-proposed and was accepted only where consistent with the inspected source frame.
Small, angled, cropped, or stylized text remains error-prone.

limitations: Twelve still frames cannot establish continuous actions or audio playback.

metaGate.rationale: All thirteen available probe carriers, ten meaning changes, ten relationship hypotheses, thirteen critical questions, and seventeen raw cues have explicit closure rows. High-resolution frames and OCR are registered as derived sources. Identity, boundary, referent, absence, carrier-conflict, segmentation, and closing audits preserve unresolved execution, TTS, and cartoon causality as unknown rather than filling them in.
